summary: Review transactional boundaries, isolation, partial failure, outbox/inbox patterns and cross-store consistency for state-changing workflows.

must_inspect.why: State transitions that must move together need a boundary or compensating design that matches the invariant.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand a single database transaction across intentionally decoupled systems with valid compensation.

must_inspect.why: Retries around ambiguous commit/side-effect outcomes need idempotent recovery.
false_positive_guards: Do not infer duplicate effects if a verified downstream idempotency boundary exists.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
